page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin, several of them in small italic type beside the lines; page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: * Johannes I. cognomento † Mercurius, * Atto, * Petrus, † Silverius, * Vigilius, † Pelagius, Iohannes III. cognomento * Cutellinus. Bonifa-cius , Diofcorus oppofitus erat, coacta Roma Synodus, Diofcori afflectas excommunicare voluit, Vrsi-um tibi fucceflorem deftinavit, fed oppofi-tione Senatoribus, lententiam fuam revocavit, Idem Michaeli Archangelo erectum in Hadriani Mole, templum deficiatur. Sub Iohanne vltimo, quondam a Tito Hierofolymitanis erepta, Iultiniani Hierofolymam translata fuit, & Zarbus, Rex Iberorum, Conftantinopoli baptizatus est, Agapetus, Conftantinopolim a Theodorico hato, ut pacem componeret, miffus, Antonium Epifcopum, hæreticos deprehenfum, condemnauit: in Synodo, Epifcopatu dejecit, & Menna Constantinopolitanus Patriarcha, Dioclesianum inuenit, à Theodahato per vim ferè - ... (remaining text partly illegible)

Vigilius, quam Anthimi reftitutionem promififlet, Vigilius ficatum obtinuit, & cùm fide fracta in indignitatem nem Imperatoris incidiffet, & ne Sylverius ... rum fubftitueretur, metueret, fibi a Belisario ... ditum, in Palmeriam infulam deportatus ...

Sub eo fefium Hypapantes leu purificationis ... rs * institutum, in tertia Aureliani ... neà die Coenæ Domini, per totum decincē ... triduum Christiani fefe Iudæis immifcere, ... bem quoquo modo circumire liceret, Iancitium ... in celebratione Paschæ apud Orientem ...

page.notes: The text is a heavily shadowed, faded scan; many words in the right portion and the margin notes are illegible and are transcribed only approximately or left unmarked. Marginal notes on the left include references such as Baron. T. 7, Cedrenus, Niceph. l. 17, Zonaras, Caranza in Concil., and others, which are not fully legible.
